[[File:animals_preview2.png|200px|right]]''Dwarf Fortress'' features a wide variety of '''animals'''. Some, you can bring with you when you first set off on your journey, others [[immigrant]]s will bring with them, and lots more will show up roaming the wilderness. Some can be [[tame]]d, others may become [[pet]]s or [[mount]]s, some make good [[hunting]] targets, some can be bred for [[livestock]]...and yet, others, like the dread [[elephant]], can be dangerous terrors.
